input_fields.name: script_artifact
input_fields.description: Readable .scscript path, SHA-256, package/version metadata, and operation identity.

input_fields.name: target_session
input_fields.description: Confirmed SpaceClaim session identity and current idle/document state.

result_fields.name: loaded_script_identity
result_fields.description: Actual loaded path, SHA-256, operation identity, and session/document binding.

result_fields.name: load_state
result_fields.description: One of loaded, rejected, or needs_manual_review; loaded does not mean executed.

procedure: Check readability, .scscript packaging, SHA-256, operation identity, session identity, and active document state.
Use the target session's script-load command once and observe the loaded script identity.
Return loaded_script_identity and load_state; keep the run gate closed.
If an identity check fails, return needs_manual_review without pressing Run.
rejection_rules: Reject missing/unreadable/archive-invalid scripts or hash mismatch.
Do not interpret a visible script tab or loaded label as completion.
